title: Best-selling video games
prompt: Name the 10 best-selling video games of all time

source.name: Wikipedia: List of best-selling video games

fact.text: Alexey Pajitnov named it by combining "tetra", meaning four, with his favorite sport, tennis.
Microsoft's $2.5 billion purchase followed a tweet in which creator Notch asked a corporation to buy his stake.

answers.name: Grand Theft Auto V
aliases: Controversies surrounding Grand Theft Auto V

fact.text: Its marketing included a website for a fictional cult, the Epsilon Program, offering fans a spot in the game as members.
Your outlaw gains or loses weight depending on how much he eats, and his hair grows realistically over time.
After remotes kept flying out of players' hands, Nintendo offered replacement wrist straps almost twice as thick.
Nintendo patched an Inkling Girl pose that means "bring it on" in Japan but looks obscene in Europe.
The shrinking safe zone is a circle because Brendan Greene wanted squares but was too new to coding.
It came out earlier than planned because a beta version from a closed playtest leaked to the public.
One person designed all of Oblivion's dungeons; Skyrim's 150 took a team of eight.
CD Projekt marketed it as "Skyrim in a Game of Thrones sauce".
